title: Jack Pumpkinhead's Ride to the Emerald City
chineseTitle: 1. 约克南瓜头前往翡翠城之旅

paragraphs.en: At daybreak, Tip was awakened by Pumpkinhead. After washing and eating, they set off for the Emerald City. The journey resumed as the Saw-Horse carried them.
paragraphs.zh: 黎明时分，蒂普被杰克南瓜头唤醒。洗漱完毕后，他们便启程前往翡翠城。骑在木马背上，旅程又重新开始了。

paragraphs.en: Tip noticed the grass and trees had changed from a purple tint to a dull lavender, which gradually turned green as they approached the city ruled by the Scarecrow.
paragraphs.zh: 提普注意到沿途的草木由紫色逐渐变成了淡紫，随着他们接近由稻草人统治的城市，颜色又渐渐转为了绿色。

paragraphs.en: After traveling two miles, they encountered a swift river blocking their path. Tip found a ferryman approaching in his boat. When asked for passage, the man demanded money, which Tip did not have.
paragraphs.zh: 行进了两英里后，他们遇到了一条湍急的河流挡住了去路。蒂普在河中发现了一艘小船正有摆渡人靠近。当询问过河事宜时，那人索要费用，而蒂普身上却没有带钱。

paragraphs.en: "Then I'll not break my back rowing you over," said the ferryman gruffly.
paragraphs.zh: “那我可不会累死自己来划船送你过去，”渡船夫粗声粗气地说。

paragraphs.en: Pumpkinhead smiled and remarked, "What a nice man!"
paragraphs.zh: 杰克南瓜头微笑着说道：“真是个好人！”

paragraphs.en: The ferryman ignored him and refused to help. Tip was disappointed but determined to reach the Emerald City. He suggested using the Saw-Horse as a makeshift boat, which the horse agreed to do without hesitation.
paragraphs.zh: 渡船夫置之不理，拒绝帮忙。提普虽然有些失望，但决心还是要赶到翡翠城。他提议用锯马当作临时的船只，锯马毫不犹豫地答应了。

paragraphs.en: Tip led the Saw-Horse into the water, climbed on its back, and had Jack wade in up to his knees, holding onto the horse's tail to keep his head above water.
paragraphs.zh: 提普领着木马走进水中，自己爬上了马背，然后让杰克涉水而入，直到膝盖深的位置，杰克抓住木马的尾巴，以保持头部不沉入水中。

paragraphs.en: Tip instructed the Saw-Horse to wiggle its legs as oars. The horse complied, moving them across the river successfully. They climbed up the wet bank, with Tip's clothes soaked but his lower half dry and the Pumpkinhead dripping.
paragraphs.zh: 提普吩咐木马像桨一样摇动它的腿。木马遵照指示，成功地划过了河。他们爬上潮湿的河岸，提普的衣服湿透了，但下半身还干着，而杰克南瓜头则浑身滴水。

paragraphs.en: "Sun will soon dry us," said Tip. "We are safely across."
paragraphs.zh: “太阳快晒干我们了，”提普说道，“我们现在安全过来了。”

paragraphs.en: The horse agreed it was no trouble to swim. Jack added he didn't mind either.
paragraphs.zh: 马儿同意说游泳没什么麻烦。杰克补充道他自己也不介意。

paragraphs.en: They resumed their journey on the yellow brick road, which continued from the other side. Tip mounted Jack on the Saw-Horse and instructed him to ride fast for drying purposes. He would run behind with the horse's tail.
paragraphs.zh: 他们重新上路，继续沿着那条黄色砖石铺成的道路前行。蒂普让杰克骑在锯马身上，并嘱咐他快点骑行以便尽快干燥。蒂普则会紧随其后，拉着锯马的尾巴跟上。

paragraphs.en: "Get-up!" shouted Tip. The horse started at a good pace.
paragraphs.zh: “快起来！”提普喊道。马儿以稳健的步伐起步。

paragraphs.en: "Trot!" commanded Tip again, making the horse speed up. Tip struggled to keep up, running faster than ever before.
paragraphs.zh: “ Trot！ ”提普再次命令道，催促马匹加快速度。提普竭力跟上，跑得比以往任何时候都快。

paragraphs.en: Soon out of breath, he couldn't call "Whoa!" as the branch broke away. Dust covered him while the horse and Jack sped off, disappearing in the distance.
paragraphs.zh: 气喘吁吁，他已经来不及喊“停！”树枝断裂的一瞬间，尘土飞扬，马和杰克 Pumpkinhead 轰然远去，渐渐消失在远方。

paragraphs.en: By the time Tip recovered, it was too late; the horse had already vanished from sight.
paragraphs.zh: 等提皮完全恢复过来，已经太晚了，那匹马早已无影无踪。

paragraphs.en: Jack decided to rest after his journey. He sat by the roadside, then resumed walking towards the Emerald City. Unaware that Tip was left behind, Jack continued his journey, noting the bright emerald-green surroundings as they approached the city.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克决定在旅程后休息一下。他坐在路边，然后继续踏上前往翡翠城的路。不知Tip已被落下，杰克继续前行，沿途注意到四周渐渐呈现出明亮的碧绿色，直到接近城市。

paragraphs.en: A high wall of green stone, studded with emeralds, soon appeared before them. Concerned about the Saw-Horse's lack of direction, Jack shouted "Whoa!" loudly to stop it.
paragraphs.zh: 一片镶满绿宝石的翠绿色石墙不久便出现在他们面前。见马驹似乎不知方向，杰克高声喊道：“吁！”猛地拉住了缰绳。

paragraphs.en: The sudden halt nearly threw him off the horse’s back, but he managed to stay on.
paragraphs.zh: 突如其来的停顿差点让他从马背上摔下来，但他还是稳住了身子。

paragraphs.en: "Such a swift ride, dear father!" Jack exclaimed, only realizing Tip was missing when no response came. This puzzled and worried him as he pondered what to do next.
paragraphs.zh: “如此迅疾的旅程，亲爱的爸爸！”杰克脱口而出，只在没有收到提普的回应时才意识到提普不见了。这让他感到困惑和担忧，他开始思索接下来该怎么做。

paragraphs.en: The gate in the green wall opened, revealing a short, round man with a good-natured face dressed entirely in green. He wore a peaked hat and green spectacles. Bowing, the man asked Jack who he was and why he had come.
paragraphs.zh: 绿墙上的门开了，露出一个身材矮小、圆脸的男子，脸上带着和善的表情，全身穿着绿色的衣服。他戴着尖顶帽，还戴着眼镜。男子向杰克鞠了一躬，询问他是谁，为何而来。

paragraphs.en: Jack introduced himself as Jack Pumpkinhead but admitted he didn’t know his purpose. The Guardian seemed surprised by this answer and questioned whether Jack was human or pumpkin.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克自我介绍为杰克南瓜头，但坦言自己并不清楚自己的使命所在。守护者对这个回答显得有些惊讶，进而质疑杰克究竟是人还是南瓜制成的生物。

paragraphs.en: The Saw-Horse responded by rolling one eye up and winking at Jack before prancing and kicking the Guardian in the toe, much to everyone's surprise.
paragraphs.zh: 小锯马回应的方式是抬起一只眼睛眨眼示意给杰克，然后尥蹶子踢了守护者一脚，让大家大吃一惊。

paragraphs.en: Jack Pumpkinhead rode the Saw-Horse through the gateway into a small room built into the wall. The Guardian pulled a bell-cord, and a tall soldier in a green uniform entered from the opposite door. The soldier had long green whiskers reaching to his knees.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克·南瓜头骑着锯马穿过大门，进入了一间嵌在墙内的小房间。守卫拉了拉铃绳，一名身穿绿色制服的高大士兵从对面的门走进来。这名士兵长着两撇垂至膝盖的绿色胡须。

paragraphs.en: "Here is a stranger who doesn't know why he's here or what he wants," said the Guardian. "What should we do with him?"
paragraphs.zh: “这位陌生人似乎不知道自己为何在此，也不知道想要什么，”守护者说道，“我们应该怎么处置他呢？”

paragraphs.en: The Soldier with Green Whiskers examined Jack carefully and nodded, causing ripples in his whiskers. He declared that Jack must be taken to His Majesty, the Scarecrow.
paragraphs.zh: 绿胡须的士兵仔细打量着杰克，点了点头，只见他浓密的胡子微微颤动。他断言杰克必须被带到那位伟大的稻草人国王面前。

paragraphs.en: "But what will the Scarecrow do?" asked the Guardian.
paragraphs.zh: “那么稻草人会怎么做呢？”守护者问道。

paragraphs.en: "That's His Majesty's business," replied the soldier. "I'll take him to the royal palace."
paragraphs.zh: “这是陛下的事务，”士兵回答道，“我将把他送到王宫。”

paragraphs.en: The Guardian opened a box of spectacles and tried to fit them on Jack's large eyes. "I don't have a pair that fits properly," he sighed, adding, "and your head is so big I’ll need to tie these on."
paragraphs.zh: 守护者打开一个眼镜盒，试图给杰克那双大眼睛戴上合适的眼镜。“我没有一副合适的眼镜，”他叹了口气，又补充道，“而且你的脑袋这么大，我得把它们绑上去才行。”

paragraphs.en: "Why do I need glasses?" asked Jack.
paragraphs.zh: “我为什么要戴眼镜？”杰克问道。

paragraphs.en: "It’s the fashion here," said the soldier. "They'll protect you from being blinded by the Emerald City's glitter and glare."
paragraphs.zh: “这里流行这么做，”士兵说道，“他们会保护你，以免被翡翠城的炫目光芒和耀眼所迷惑。”

paragraphs.en: "Alright," agreed Jack. "Tie them on if you must."
paragraphs.zh: “好吧，”杰克应道，“如果一定要的话，就把它们绑上去吧。”

paragraphs.en: The Saw-Horse chimed in, "I don't want to be blinded either!" A pair of green spectacles was quickly placed over the knots that served as Jack’s eyes.
paragraphs.zh: 木马接口道：“我可不想被蒙蔽！”说着，一副绿色的眼镜迅速戴到了充当杰克眼睛的树节上。

paragraphs.en: Upon entering the Emerald City, Jack Pumpkinhead and the Saw-Horse were led by the Soldier with Green Whiskers down the main street. The houses and towers sparkled with green gems, and even the marble pavement gleamed with precious stones. However, the Pumpkinhead and the Saw-Horse paid little attention to these wonders.
paragraphs.zh: 进入翡翠城后，杰克南瓜头和木马由绿胡子士兵引领着走在主要街道上。两旁的房屋和塔楼闪烁着绿色宝石的光芒，就连大理石铺路也映衬着珍贵的宝石。然而，对于杰克南瓜头和木马来说，这些奇观并没有引起多少注意。

paragraphs.en: The Soldier guided them past the crowds of green people who stared at them curiously. When a green dog barked, the Saw-Horse kicked it away, sending the animal howling into a house. They continued to the royal palace without further incident.
paragraphs.zh: 士兵带领他们穿过一群好奇地盯着他们的绿皮人。当一只绿狗叫了一声，木马用蹄子把它踢开，吓得那动物嚎叫着跑进了房子。随后，他们平安无事地继续前往王宫。

paragraphs.en: Jack wished to ride directly up the green marble steps to meet the Scarecrow, but the soldier forbade him. Dismounting with difficulty, Jack was led inside by a servant while the Soldier escorted the Saw-Horse around to the back.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克希望能直接骑上那绿色大理石台阶去见稻草人，但士兵不允许他这样做。杰克艰难地下了马驹，随后被一名仆人领进了屋内，而士兵则带着锯木马绕到后面去了。

paragraphs.en: Left in a beautifully furnished waiting room, Jack waited as the soldier announced his arrival. The Scarecrow, bored and idle, ordered Jack to be shown into his throne room immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 被留下在一间装饰得十分考究的候客厅里，杰克等待着士兵宣布他的到来。稻草人无聊且无所事事，命令立刻将杰克带到他的王座室。

paragraphs.en: Jack entered the room, amazed at seeing His Majesty seated on his glittering throne for the first time.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克走进房间，惊讶地看到这位陛下第一次坐在那闪耀的王座上。
